name: Gradient-Aware Super Sampling (GASS)
definition: A post-rendering module that leverages the continuous differentiability of 3DGS to extract image gradients, which guide a GRU-based refinement network to enable high-fidelity super sampling from low-resolution inputs.
summary: Gradient-Aware Super Sampling is a post-rendering module that uses 3D Gaussian Splatting's differentiability to extract image gradients, guiding a refinement network for high-fidelity super sampling that outperforms UpscaleGS.
